speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Minister for Trade and Industry (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
text: The Ministry of Trade and Industry (MTI) will refresh Singapore’s economic blueprint and keep our economy strong and resilient in a changed world.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Minister for Trade and Industry (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
text: We will position Singapore as a home to leading firms, a key global business hub, and a vital connector in the global economy.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Minister for Trade and Industry (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
text: Through these efforts, we will foster productivity-led and innovation-driven growth and create good jobs for Singaporeans.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Minister for Trade and Industry (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
text: We are operating in a changed world, marked by major uncertainties and structural shifts.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Minister for Trade and Industry (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
text: We will seize opportunities in the green and digital economy.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Minister for Trade and Industry (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
text: MTI will sustain investments in research and development, to encourage widespread innovation and bring new products and services to the market.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Minister for Trade and Industry (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
text: This includes stronger collaborations between industry and academia, and next-generation infrastructure such as the Punggol Digital District, to support our growth enterprises.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Minister for Trade and Industry (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
text: We will continue to encourage investments in our tourism and lifestyle sectors, and contribute to the vibrancy of Singapore as a city to live, work and play.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Minister for Trade and Industry (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
text: MTI will continue to attract globally leading companies by leveraging and improving our efficient infrastructure, extensive connectivity, highly skilled workforce and pro-business environment.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Minister for Trade and Industry (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
text: Anchoring these firms in Singapore enables us to access global markets, deepen capital formation, acquire cutting-edge technologies and know-how, and help our small and medium-sized enterprises plug into global supply chains.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Minister for Trade and Industry (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
text: We will raise the productivity of local enterprises, by accelerating the adoption of digital and AI-enabled solutions and supporting workforce training.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Minister for Trade and Industry (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
text: We will also explore carbon capture, utilisation and storage technologies and develop markets for high-quality carbon credits.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Minister for Trade and Industry (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
text: Amid global shifts, Singapore must remain a trusted and connected business hub, deeply integrated into global supply chains and trade flows.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Minister for Trade and Industry (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
text: MTI will deepen regional economic integration in the Association of Southeast Asian Nations (ASEAN) and enhance linkages with our neighbours, enhancing Singapore’s value proposition as a base for investments into the region.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Minister for Trade and Industry (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
text: We will also strengthen ASEAN’s partnership with major economies and other economic blocs, such as the European Union and the Gulf Cooperation Council, to enhance ASEAN’s role in the global trade architecture.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Minister for Trade and Industry (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
text: At the same time, we will further cooperation in strategic growth areas.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Minister for Trade and Industry (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
text: For example, we are expanding our network of Digital Economy Agreements to establish rules and standards around issues such as personal data and online consumer protection, enabling businesses to operate more seamlessly across borders.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Minister for Trade and Industry (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
text: We are also advancing Green Economy Agreements to catalyse trade and investment flows that support the low-carbon transition of our economy.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Minister for Trade and Industry (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
text: MTI will work with like-minded partners to support the rules-based trading system, to help businesses navigate uncertainty and seize new opportunities.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Minister for Trade and Industry (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
text: Our people are at the heart of our economy.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Minister for Trade and Industry (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
text: Our strategies will create more opportunities for Singaporeans to thrive and share in the benefits of growth.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Minister for Trade and Industry (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
text: MTI will work with companies, unions, trade associations and chambers, as well as the Ministry of Manpower and Ministry of Education, to equip citizens with future-ready, industry-relevant skills and support career transitions into growth sectors.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Minister for Trade and Industry (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
text: In doing so, we will ensure that every Singaporean can aspire to good jobs, secure progress and build a better future for themselves and their families.
